annotations.text:
The top block is persistent across all five tabs.
In the real sheet it lives outside the tab PARTS so switching tabs never re-renders it.

Equipment tab: weapon modes show the printed formula (sw+1) resolved against this character's ST (1d+3).
That lookup is the most tedious part of GURPS at the table.
Palette and type lifted from Foundry v14's own foundry2.css: Signika, warm-1 #ee9b3a, deep #5d142b, parchment #f7f3e8 / #efe6d8 / #e7d1b1, borders #c9c7b8 / #b5b3a4.
